content:
As a result of its connection to academia, BUILT CoLAB has participated in several dissertation supervision processes, as well as in the assessment of other final Master’s Thesis presentations.

In the European Master’s Degree in BIM A+ at the University of Minho:

Thesis: “AI and Photogrammetry for HBIM: Automating Historic Building Classification and Modelling”

Student: Oxana Barsukova | Supervisor: Bruno Figueiredo (EAAD); Co-supervisor: Filipe Brandão (EAAD), Luís Sanhudo (BUILT CoLAB)

Thesis: “AI-Driven System to Support Early-Stage Floor Plan Generation”

Student: Gabriela Debarba | Supervisor: Bruno Figueiredo (EAAD), Co-supervisor: Filipe Brandão (EAAD), João Silva (BUILT CoLAB)

In the European Master’s Degree MBUILD – Sustainable Design, Construction and Management of Built Environments, from FEUP:

Thesis: “Adopting ESG in Emerging Markets: Challenges and Opportunities for Sustainable Construction”

Student: Reham Baher Fouad Mohamed Thabet | Supervisor: João Poças Martins (FEUP); Co-supervisor de Vanessa Tavares (BUILT CoLAB); Arguência de Rita Mendonça (BUILT CoLAB)

In the Master’s Degree in Civil Engineering, specialising in Construction, at FEUP:

Thesis: “Modelação paramétrica BIM para análise de ciclo de vida”

Student: Miguel Costa e Silva | Supervisor: João Poças Martins; Arguência de Vanessa Tavares

These guidelines and arguments enable BUILT CoLAB to maintain its proximity to knowledge hubs, increasing the possibility of transferring new ideas to industry.
